Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Count Germaine
Clan: Brujah (group 4)
Capacity: 8
Disciplines: CEL FOR POT PRE obf
Camarilla: Minions opposing Germaine in combat cannot use weapons.
Germaine can enter combat with any Toreador controlled by another
Methuselah as a (D) action.

Cleave
Type: Combat
Requires: Vengeance
Choose a melee weapon this imbued has or spend 1 conviction to put this
card on this imbued to represent a melee weapon that does strength
damage each strike. This melee weapon inflicts +1 additional damage
this action. If the opposing minion is (or becomes) immune to
non-aggravated damage, he or she loses that immunity for handling
damage from this weapon. Burn the melee weapon at the end of the
action.

Can an imbued play cleave when in combat with Count Germain?

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp
